rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a high-quality hatching/expanded blastocyst and appropriately identifies favorable ICM and TE, but it is somewhat hedged and includes stage ambiguity rather than a precise image-grounded read.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, prior miscarriage, semen parameters, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with the implantation estimate appropriately tempered by endometrial thickness; minor issue is repeated emphasis on possible hydrosalpinx without explicit case confirmation.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation, SET principles, luteal support, and concern for thin lining/hydrosalpinx; slight overreach in suggesting deferral based on unconfirmed hydrosalpinx and somewhat broad probability framing.
Provides practical recommendations on SET, luteal support, lifestyle, tubal evaluation, and future PGT-A/FET considerations, though some advice remains conditional rather than tightly case-specific.
